title: Name/secure the License+Data-Ethics and Domain reviewer roles
context: bioinformatics-from-zero gates every dataset and every clinical-interpretation lesson behind named human reviewers (License+Data-Ethics and an oncology-aware Domain reviewer). Several medium-risk tasks (M2 cancer-genomics, stats-104) are blocked until these roles are filled. This task documents the role definitions and the search to secure them.
objective: Produce a reviewer-roles document that defines the License+Data-Ethics and Domain (oncology-aware) reviewer responsibilities, qualification bar, and a shortlist/status for securing each, so blocking review gates have an owner or an explicit 'TO BE SECURED'.
acceptanceCriteria: Defines responsibilities, qualification bar, and sign-off authority for the License+Data-Ethics reviewer (blocking dataset gate) and the oncology-aware Domain reviewer.
Records the current status of each role as a named person/program or an explicit 'TO BE SECURED', with no fabricated commitments.
States which milestones/tasks are blocked until each role is secured (e.g. M2 is blocked on the Domain reviewer).
